method: Each circuit is transpiled with every transpiler seed at each optimization level; the seed with the fewest two-qubit gates (then lowest depth) is kept. Selection uses compile metrics only.
The kept circuit is simulated on Qiskit Aer with the fake backend's noise model, `repeats` times with simulator seeds simulator_seed_base + i.
Exact distributions come from the noise-free statevector. Metrics: TVD and Hellinger fidelity (counts circuits), approximation ratio (QAOA).

config.seed_selection: gates: fewest two-qubit gates, then depth, then seed
